Silver Coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), mint of Rome, probably RIC volume 2 no. 94, Reece period 5, issue of 101-111. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, clean-shaven. Obverse inscription: IMP TRAIANO AVG GER.DAC.PM.TRP. Reverse description: Female draped figure standing facing left, Arabia, holding ?scroll and with right arm extended holding ?branch, camel lower left. Reverse…
